request_text: Load case14, set the active load at bus 14 to 17.2 MW, disconnect the line between bus 1 and bus 5, reconnect the line between bus 1 and bus 5, and finally run an N-1 contingency analysis ranked by min voltage and report the 8 worst outages.
answer:
Bus ids are the net.bus name values 1 through 14. Bus 1 is the slack with fixed 1.06 p.u. and 0 degrees. Generator buses are 2, 3, 6, 8 with specified voltage setpoints, and load buses include 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14. The requested load change is at bus 14 from 13.990817 MW to 17.2 MW.

Branches include 15 lines with line_id equal to the net.line row index 0 through 14, and 5 transformers with line_id equal to 100000 plus the net.trafo row index, so 100000 through 100004. The line mentioned in the switching action is line 1, connecting bus 1 to bus 5. It is disconnected and then reconnected, so the final solved topology is the original topology with that line in service.

The requested quantities are bus voltage magnitude in per unit and angle in degrees, branch active power at the from or hv side in MW, and loading percent. Since thermal ratings are undefined, loading_percent is reported as 0 for every branch. Totals requested are total generation MW, total load MW, and total losses MW.

Relative to the base case, only the final active load at bus 14 changes to 17.2 MW. The disconnect and reconnect of line 1 to 5 cancel out before the final power flow. In AC power flow, total generation equals total load plus total real losses. Voltage overrun checking is against less than 0.95 p.u. or greater than 1.05 p.u., and branch overrun checking is against loading greater than 100 percent, though all reported loadings are 0 because ratings are undefined.
